examples: The sailors sent a distress signal when the storm damaged their boat.

examples: The highway has a maximum speed of 120 kilometers per hour.

examples: He called her the next morning to apologize for his rude behavior.

examples: Newborn animals are especially vulnerable to predators in the wild.
